prompt: STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC PROJECTION, 45-DEGREE TOP-DOWN CAMERA. Camera tilted downward exactly 45 degrees, diagonal view of the street. Parallel projection: parallel edges remain parallel, no vanishing points, no perspective foreshortening with distance; identical objects retain the same scale near and far. Atmospheric photorealistic 3D environment, Unreal Engine 5 visual quality, realistic materials and cinematic lighting. A snow-covered bus stop in an old industrial neighborhood of Northeast China at night. One elderly woman in a thick dark winter coat sits quietly on a wooden bench beneath a rusty corrugated-metal shelter. Snow lies heavily on the shelter roof, low brick walls and a parked truck. Footprints and tire tracks cross the snow and wet slush on the road. Weathered red-brick workers housing and shuttered shops recede into a thin layer of winter fog. A single dim streetlamp softly illuminates the woman and drifting snowflakes, a few distant windows glow through the darkness. Realistic snow crystals, damp concrete, corroded metal and rough brickwork, physically based surface shading, bounced light, soft contact shadows, subtle volumetric fog, strong three-dimensional depth. Natural subdued winter colors, quiet, lonely, cold, immersive atmosphere. A continuous full-scale street with open pavement in the foreground. --ar 16:9 --raw --v 8.1 --relax --no perspective projection, vanishing point, wide-angle lens, painting, illustration, brushstrokes, cartoon, miniature, interface, text, watermark, extra people
